Coca Cola (KO) vs Advanced Micro Devices (AMD): on the same formula, their operating margins are 18.0 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — KO: $47.9B · AMD: $34.6B
• Revenue growth — KO: +1.9% · AMD: +34.3%
• Operating margin — KO: 28.7% · AMD: 10.7%
• Net margin — KO: 27.3% · AMD: 12.5%
• Free cash flow margin — KO: 11.0% · AMD: 19.4%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — KO: 5.5% · AMD: 20.5%

Different fiscal years: KO Dec 31, 2025 · AMD Dec 27, 2025. The periods are not identical.
